text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san, thank you so much for the 
birthday present! Um, that man-catcher... 
no, that jutte-like weapon...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...? ...! Could it be, you're talking 
about the U-shaped hair comb I gave you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's an accessory! It's a hair clasp for 
putting hair up, just like a kanzashi 
hairpin.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~~! Hairpins...! There are so many 
different kinds...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Fenomeno-san. Would you allow me to 
give you something formless?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, without fail. Come to my room. I 
shall instruct you on the proper way to 
carry accessories.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You'll show me the ropes?! But I couldn't 
possibly trouble someone as busy as you—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: The choker I gave you before.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Who wrapped this around their arm instead 
of their neck?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...One's attire affects not only oneself, 
but also the impression made by whoever 
stands beside you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Whether I have good fashion sense or not?! 
Could affect the Boss's reputation?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Ghh, Gentildonna-san! We have a major 
problem, ma'am!! Could you please give me 
some guidance, sir!?
